policy.selection: Official Anthropic/OpenAI/GitHub product review first; community tools must meet popularity plus quality, activity, permission and relevance tests; star count alone insufficient.

tools.name: Claude Code Review (official plugin)
tools.permissions: May post PR review comments; do not trigger without explicit authorization to mutate GitHub.
tools.notes: Best for PR changes; confirm installed plugin, CLI support and GitHub permissions. Do not confuse with hosted Team/Enterprise review.

tools.name: Claude Code Review (hosted, official)
tools.evidence: First-party Anthropic service, September 2026; research preview
tools.permissions: Separately billed, posts GitHub review feedback; never activate or trigger automatically.
tools.notes: Reconcile already-generated comments only unless user explicitly requests and has plan access.

tools.name: Codex Code Review (official)
tools.access: native local review / Code Review interface
tools.permissions: Prefer read-only local /review or available prior findings; @codex review and GitHub comment posting require explicit authorization.
tools.notes: Review exact diff and repo rules. Local native review can be used without triggering cloud PR posting when available.

tools.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
tools.permissions: No external run by default; use public verified receipts or ask before CLI scans.
tools.notes: Security posture only; not a bug verification engine.

tools.name: OSV-Scanner
tools.permissions: Network/advisory lookup may transmit dependency identifiers; opt-in.
tools.notes: Checks known dependency vulnerabilities, not source correctness.

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.permissions: Do not enable cloud upload, arbitrary rules or source transmission without approval.

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.permissions: May uncover historical secrets. Never publish raw findings or run without authorization.

tools.name: GitHub CodeQL Action
tools.permissions: Read previously configured code-scanning alerts; do not install or enable automatically.
tools.notes: Security coverage depends on language/query suite.

tools.name: zizmor
tools.permissions: Inspect GitHub Actions definitions; never auto-fix.
tools.notes: GitHub Actions security, not code duplication.

tools.name: lychee
tools.permissions: Link checks may request network/private URLs; permission required.
